name: prompt-jump
description: Jump back to any prompt you sent in a long Claude Code session: a prompt index pane, /prev /next /jump, bookmarks. 對話目錄：列出你問過的每一則，點一下或打 /jump 就捲回那裡。

autoOpenPane.title: Open the pane at start / 啟動時自動打開窗格
autoOpenPane.description: Open the prompt list beside the chat when a session starts (it shows once the terminal is wide enough). Off (the default since 0.3.0): the tick row above the prompt is always there; press l on it or type /jump to open the list. 每次開始對話就打開清單（終端機夠寬時才會顯示）。關（0.3.0 起的預設）：提示框上方的刻度列一直都在，按 l 或打 /jump 再打開清單。

language.title: Language / 介面語言
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; falls back to English. auto 依 Claude Code 的語言設定、再依系統語言；都判斷不出時用英文。

titles.title: Auto titles (sends text to a model) / 自動標題（會把文字送給模型）
titles.description: Off by default. On: after each turn the prompt and the start of the answer (about 300 characters each) and the names of edited files are sent to a model to write a one-line title, one extra model call per turn, counted in your usage. Off: nothing is sent; the index shows your prompt as typed. 預設關。開啟後，每輪結束會把提問與回答開頭（各約 300 字）和改過的檔名送給模型寫一行標題，每輪多一次模型呼叫，算進你的用量。關閉時不送出任何東西，目錄顯示原本的提問。

titleModel.title: Model for auto titles / 自動標題用的模型
titleModel.description: An alias or a full model id; used only when auto titles are on. 別名或完整 model id；只有自動標題開啟時才會用到。
